title: Nexperia and Tata form a manufacturing partnership, preparing for MOSFET production at a 300mm fab in India
excerpt: We explain the manufacturing partnership in India that Nexperia and Tata Electronics announced on September 17, 2026. We cover how MOSFETs and the front-end and back-end processes work, the investment plan for the whole fab and the unannounced mass production schedule, and what it means for the supply chain.
